title: Hook READMEs still document the mirror gate as block-or-allow; the new exit-3 skip is undocumented

detail: Security pass over path handling, generated shell quoting, MIRROR_RC branching and the not-checkable skip; no P0/P1, one new P2 doc-behavior drift.

direction: Shell injection via the regenerated .codex/hooks.json fallback message
reason: New message has no single quote, dollar, backtick or backslash; all 19 decoded payloads pass bash -n, none contains a single quote, and all 18 envelope bindings re-emit valid JSON (iteration 2).

direction: Mirror-gate bypass by inducing the exit-3 not-checkable skip
reason: The skip warns loudly, names the build remedy, is specific to a missing built parser, and the documented SYSTEM_GIT_COMMIT_HOOKS_DISABLED=1 is an easier bypass; the agent-mirror-sync workflow runs the checker but its non-zero handling needs re-checking (iteration 2).

direction: Pi notice path injection through ctx.cwd
reason: The joined suffix is a static literal and the check only tests existence; the spawn path is pre-existing adapter code (iteration 2).

direction: Exit-code 3 collision with another checker meaning
reason: 3 is emitted only from the NOT_CHECKABLE branch; both hooks special-case exactly 3 and block every other non-zero; no other caller executes the checker (iteration 2).

label: bash -n and envelope reparse over 19 codex commands
